document: The half-marathon editions of the release that the runner lookup lists and never compares. analysis/build_runner_lookup.py reads this file and stops when the release gives another set. Which half rows never appear is not stated here: it is the identity file’s `left_out` status, the half row rule the lead froze (decision D28, HALF_ROW_RULE in analysis/adapt_combined.py), and the builder reads it from that file alone.

no_comparison.words: These editions are listed with their results and marked; a marked edition's results are never compared with other years or races and never enter a best, a ranking or an average. Editions are [source database, release key, year].

gun_times.rule: the release's edition_meta.timing_basis starts with "gross" (lead decision D6; the build stops unless that set equals this list)

course_suspected_short.rule: every row of the edition carries course_shortened_suspect in the person-links file (lead decision D24.10; the build stops unless the flagged editions equal this list and are flagged in full)
